initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream job. The top-level corpus has eight qualifying demand records with demand_score >= 3, including n06-r01, and select_demand retains eight rows. The upstream normalize function then filters with an allowed_record_ids list that replaces n06-r01 with nonexistent n06-r09, producing a seven-row needs handoff that silently omits stipulated record n06-r01. Job 2 consumed the exact upstream handoffs and preserved the seven records it received, so the supported localization is job_1 normalize.
